integrity: Complete explicit finite CW attaching-map argument; numerical experiments are not treated as a proof of the infinite theorem. No independent validation claimed.
scientific_limitations: Ordinary geometric row-C3 quotient only, integer n>=5; no classification of other groups or wider row counts. Finite checker supplements a uniform symbolic proof. Publication priority can be affected by unindexed equivalent literature.
title: Moore-space homotopy classification of cyclic-row quotients of three-row chessboard complexes
